title: Funds Availability of Entrance Fee Agreement Deposits by Payment Instrument
content:
Escrow interest on the deposit of an **Entrance Fee Agreement** accrues from the day the deposit funds were available: a deposit paid by personal check accrues from 5 days after it was posted, a deposit paid by one-time ACH accrues from 2 days after it was posted, and a deposit paid by wire transfer or certified check accrues from the day it was posted; the accrual days never fall below 0.

The accrual days are counted to the cancellation date. The instrument is the payment method recorded on the deposit payment entry of the agreement's ledger.

## Instrument table

| Deposit instrument | Interest accrues from | Accrual days |
|---|---|---|
| Personal check | 5 days after posting | Days held less 5, never below 0 |
| One-time ACH | 2 days after posting | Days held less 2, never below 0 |
| Wire transfer | The posting day | Days held |
| Certified check | The posting day | Days held |

Days held are the calendar days from the day the deposit was posted to the cancellation date.

## Hypothetical illustration (deposit posted 1 March, cancellation 30 May, 90 days held)

| Instrument | Accrual days |
|---|---|
| Personal check | 85 |
| One-time ACH | 88 |
| Wire transfer or certified check | 90 |

## Short holdings

A personal check deposit cancelled 3 days after posting has 0 accrual days, not a negative count; a one-time ACH deposit cancelled 2 days after posting also has 0.
